name: Carlos Ramirez
bio:
Carlos Ramirez's journey into the world of motorsport marketing began unconventionally, with a background in graphic design and a lifelong passion for Formula 1. Growing up in Mexico City, he was captivated by the speed and spectacle of racing. He initially worked for a small local racing team, creating promotional materials and managing their social media presence. His innovative campaigns and data-driven approach quickly gained attention, leading to opportunities with larger teams. He joined Rahal Letterman Lanigan after a successful stint at a NASCAR team. 

Carlos is known for his ability to blend traditional marketing techniques with cutting-edge digital strategies. He believes in creating immersive experiences for fans and fostering a strong sense of community around the team. His data-driven approach ensures that every marketing initiative is carefully measured and optimized for maximum impact. He’s not afraid to take risks and experiment with new ideas, always pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in motorsport marketing. He is a fierce advocate for fan engagement, using it to drive awareness and excitement around the team and the sport.

physical.description: Carlos has a warm, welcoming smile that puts people at ease.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with marketing ideas.
Starts every meeting with a brief motivational quote.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought.
